coverage: White/red/black/orange behavior, official day/week/month windows, durations, revenge and black-skull respawn penalties are captured. Official 3–5/5–9/10–19 red and 6+/10+/20+ black kill counts are labeled rule-of-thumb guidance, not deterministic thresholds. Exact unjustified-point allocation, white duration and clock boundaries are not invented.

unresolved_fields.limitation: Official notes do not give a numeric white-skull timer.
Official notes only give rule-of-thumb ranges: 3–5/24h, 5–9/7d, 10–19/30d. Exact frag-point thresholds and assist weights are not proven.
Wiki 6/10/20 kill thresholds are not controlled evidence; official notes call these rule-of-thumb values.
Rolling-vs-calendar accounting and exact reset/server-save boundaries require official or controlled evidence.

limitations_policy: UNKNOWN/CONFLICT is the owner-required outcome for unproven values; candidates, selectors and reasons remain inspectable. No unsupported number was supplied to make the packet appear complete.
